title: Clarksburg-Harrison Public Library announces new Mothman library card, Letters to Santa event
excerpt: The Clarksburg-Harrison Public Library has announced their new Mothman library card.
content:
CLARKSBURG, W.Va (WDTV) - The Clarksburg-Harrison Public Library has announced their new Mothman library card.

The limited-time Mothman library card is available for free, for new and existing patrons, through the month of November. After November, the card will continue to be available while supplies last. Card exchanges will then cost $3.

The library also announced that the Waldomore will be welcoming families for their Letters to Santa event on Saturday, Dec, 5, from 12:00 to 4:00 P.M. as part of Clarksburg’s WinterFest. During the event, visitors can meet with Santa Clause, take photos, and participate in crafts for all ages from 12:00 to 3:00 P.M.

For more information about library services, programs, and upcoming events, visit clarksburglibrary.org or follow Clarksburg-Harrison Public Library on Facebook
